clauses.1.1: Who is covered. This plan covers the enrolled international student named in the policy schedule while studying in Norland. It does not cover family members.
clauses.1.2: Cover start date. Cover starts on the date shown in your policy schedule (the cover start date). Costs from before that date are not covered.
clauses.2.1: Annual limit. The maximum we pay in any policy year is USD 50,000 for all covered benefits combined.
clauses.2.2: Policy year. A policy year runs for 12 months from the cover start date. Limits and deductibles reset at the start of each policy year.
clauses.3.1: Deductible. You pay the first USD 300 of covered outpatient and inpatient costs in each policy year before we pay.
clauses.3.2: Co-insurance. Where this plan says we pay a percentage, you pay the rest.
clauses.4.1: Inpatient care. After the deductible we pay 100% of covered inpatient costs. Room and board is limited to USD 200 per night.
clauses.4.2: Outpatient care. After the deductible we pay 80% of covered outpatient costs, up to USD 2,000 per policy year.
clauses.4.3: Emergency room. Emergency room visits are covered as outpatient care unless they lead to admission, in which case they are covered as inpatient care.
clauses.5.1: Non-emergency admission. Planned inpatient admissions in the first 30 days after the cover start date are not covered. This waiting period does not apply to emergencies.
clauses.6.1: Dental. Only emergency dental treatment after an accident or acute pain is covered, up to USD 500 per policy year. Routine cleaning, fillings and orthodontics are not covered.
clauses.6.2: Waiting period for dental. Dental benefits begin 90 days after your cover start date. This waiting period does not apply to dental treatment needed because of an accident.
clauses.7.1: General exclusions. We do not pay for conditions that existed before your cover start date, for injuries from extreme sports, or for cosmetic treatment.
clauses.7.2: Extreme sports. Extreme sports include motor racing, skydiving and free climbing.
clauses.7.3: Treatment abroad. Treatment received outside Norland is not covered by this plan. Please check your travel policy.
clauses.8.1: Claim deadline. You must submit a claim within 60 days of the treatment date.
clauses.8.2: Documents. Send the itemised bill, proof of payment and a doctor's note.
clauses.8.3: Other insurance. If another policy also covers the same cost, we pay only what remains after the other insurer's payment.
